KelThuzadThePlaguelands.name: The Plaguelands
KelThuzadThePlaguelands.description: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

KelThuzadBlightedFrost.name: Blighted Frost
KelThuzadBlightedFrost.description: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

KelThuzadBarbedChains.name: Barbed Chains
KelThuzadBarbedChains.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

KelThuzadStripShields.name: Strip Shields
KelThuzadStripShields.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128 (+4% per level) Shield, stacking up to 2 times. Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270 (+2.5% per level) bonus damage to Heroes' Shields.

KelThuzadPhylactery.name: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
KelThuzadPhylactery.description: Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery. Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again. Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phyl

KelThuzadArchlichArmor.name: Armor of the Archlich
KelThuzadArchlichArmor.description: Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

KelThuzadAcceleratedDecay.name: Accelerated Decay
KelThuzadAcceleratedDecay.description: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

KelThuzadChillingTouch.name: Chilling Touch
KelThuzadChillingTouch.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80% additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

KelThuzadIceCold.name: Ice Cold
KelThuzadIceCold.description: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

KelThuzadFrozenTomb.name: Frost Blast
KelThuzadFrozenTomb.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 (+2.5% per level) damage to its target and 275 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

KelThuzadShadowFissure.name: Shadow Fissure
KelThuzadShadowFissure.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

KelThuzadIcyGrasp.name: Icy Grasp
KelThuzadIcyGrasp.description: Increase Frost Nova's Slow by 20%. Each time Kel'Thuzad damages enemies Slowed by Frost Nova, reduce the cooldown of Frost Nova by 0.75 seconds.

KelThuzadChainsOfIce.name: Chains of Ice
KelThuzadChainsOfIce.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

KelThuzadChainLink.name: Chain-Link
KelThuzadChainLink.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.

KelThuzadArcaneEchoes.name: Arcane Echoes
KelThuzadArcaneEchoes.description: Whenever Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

KelThuzadHungeringCold.name: Hungering Cold
KelThuzadHungeringCold.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 (+2.5% per level) damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

KelThuzadPowerOfIcecrown.name: Power of Icecrown
KelThuzadPowerOfIcecrown.description: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

KelThuzadDeathchill.name: Deathchill
KelThuzadDeathchill.description: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

KelThuzadMightOfTheScourge.name: Might of the Scourge
KelThuzadMightOfTheScourge.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later. This second cast will not duplicate itself.

KelThuzadShiftingMalice.name: Shifting Malice
KelThuzadShiftingMalice.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

KelThuzadTheDamnedReturn.name: The Damned Return
KelThuzadTheDamnedReturn.description: Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.
